research_question: Can one fixed current_m3 rule use an empirically qualified extension beyond the current fallback cap, using only an approximate state and finitely many calibration observations, while preserving accuracy and classical information cost and reducing frozen quantum budget?

forbidden_interpretations: agreement of two approximate-state windows is a rigorous error bound
a small fit residual is a rigorous cap-external safety guarantee
a small eigenpair residual is a physical safety guarantee
CISD and another nearby approximate state sharing a result removes common state bias

allowed_uses: rationale for inheriting the existing 0.05 epsilon consistency threshold

independent_evaluation.status_at_protocol_freeze: no matching condition identifiers or numeric-result references found in the local worktrees or all local Git refs; GPU-server-wide search remains a mandatory preflight gate

information_source.state: determinant-space CISD in the same frozen-core/orbital space as the Hamiltonian

cost_model.units: Pauli rotations under the inherited continuous QPE resource proxy

phase_a.purpose: Generate independent Hamiltonian/CISD inputs, acquire only approximate-state proxy information, execute all four frozen strategies, and freeze every selection before opening direct truth.
allowed_selector_inputs: Hamiltonian in the frozen particle/symmetry sector
CISD proxy actions and their runtime counters
forbidden_selector_inputs: direct PF eigenvalue or signed shift
Phase B output path or truth file path

system_construction.z2_target_source: RHF determinant and CISD support only
system_construction.sector_rule: Use the fixed (N_alpha,N_beta) population sector. A nonconstant exact diagonal-Z2 restriction may be used only when its mask and target are derived without an exact eigenvector; otherwise retain the full population sector.

extension.sign_rule: The measured proxy and both adjacent-window predictions at the candidate must exceed the inherited sign noise floor and have one common nonzero sign.
extension.stop_rule: Acquire candidates in the frozen order and stop immediately at the first residual, adjacent-window, sign, numeric, or feasibility failure. Later candidates are unavailable. A consistency pass without 5 percent predicted budget reduction may be traversed but is not eligible for selection.
extension.indeterminate_or_no_eligible_candidate: return the original current_m3 selection and frozen budget

strategies.current_fallback: Original current_m3-only rule, including the 0.5 t_ana fallback cap.
strategies.equal_information_pooled_fit: Use exactly the proxy points actually acquired by the new rule, fit one [t^4,t^6] model to all of them, and select the minimum predicted-cost observed candidate without the adjacent-window gate. On infeasibility return current_fallback.
strategies.multiple_window_rule: Use the frozen sequential adjacent-window gate and guarded error. On indeterminacy return current_fallback.
strategies.uncapped_counterfactual: Use the original three-point model on the full frozen candidate list with the 0.5 cap removed. This is diagnostic only and cannot establish operational safety.

freeze.post_freeze_changes: Any scientific or selection change invalidates the run; preserve it and create a new protocol version. Do not edit the independent evaluation result.

phase_b.purpose: After a committed and hash-frozen Phase A only, compute direct current_m3 truth on the preregistered grid and score all frozen strategies.
preconditions: HEAD descends from the protocol commit
the protocol SHA-256 matches the committed sidecar
the Phase A prediction file is committed and byte-identical to prediction.sha256
the Phase A commit is present on origin
all Phase A oracle-access counters are zero
all four independent conditions and strategy selections match the frozen protocol
the output contains no existing direct cache except a resumable cache created by this exact protocol and Phase A prediction hash
the source/leakage and GPU-server-wide independence searches pass

truth_coordinate_plan.anchor_time: 0.5*min(all candidate-grid coordinates and the original current-fallback selected coordinate for that condition)

branch_rule.anchor_selection: maximum exact-ground overlap at the new anchor only
branch_rule.remaining_coordinates: ascending-time continuation by maximum previous-vector overlap
branch_rule.independent_check: record maximum exact-ground-overlap branch at every point and flag disagreement

scoring.candidate_grid_oracle: minimum finite direct required cost over the nine fixed current_m3 candidate points
scoring.selection_regret: direct required cost at the frozen selected time / candidate-grid oracle - 1
scoring.unsafe_execution: direct PF error plus the phase-estimation error implied by the frozen budget exceeds epsilon_E

primary_metrics: execution coverage, extension coverage, and consistency-rejection count
frozen Pauli-rotation budget per condition and in aggregate
selection and frozen-budget regret relative to the fixed current_m3 candidate grid
explicit Hamiltonian-vector actions and Hamiltonian-exponential actions
group count, group-spectrum builds, and their seconds
Phase B direct-coordinate count, GPU seconds, and CPU/GPU peak memory

go_to_phase_a: local and GPU-server-wide searches find no prior PF-error, QPE-cost, proxy-response, or direct-truth result for any of the four independent conditions
the implementation and all boundary tests pass
the output roots are new and non-overwriting
go_to_phase_b: Phase A completed without exact/direct truth access
Phase A predictions and coordinate plan are committed, pushed, and SHA-256 frozen
the Phase B direct count is at most 44
decision.complete_no_benefit: All source and numerical gates pass but one or more benefit conditions fail. Preserve and publish the fixed negative result without retuning.
no_go_or_failed: Phase A truth leakage or prediction hash mismatch
unplanned direct coordinate or cache reuse

resource_estimate.basis: Existing 8-active-orbital current_m3 runs had restricted dimension 1568, 81-99 groups, Phase A preparation 7.45-11.37 s, proxy action about 0.18 s, CPU peak about 0.75 GiB, and direct points with median 4.19-4.84 s, maximum 11.75 s, and GPU maximum 701 MiB. LiF may have a larger frozen sector, so the estimate is deliberately widened.

stop_rules: Stop after protocol commit and push; do not generate the new molecules, run Phase A, or run Phase B in the protocol-preparation task.
During execution, stop after Phase A commit and push until its hash boundary is independently verified.
After the one independent Phase B evaluation, do not retune thresholds, candidate times, state truncation, basis, geometry, safety multiplier, or selection rule on LiF/HCl.
Do not start S5, another PF, another molecule, another basis, or another target accuracy automatically.
A no-benefit outcome is a complete result for this information source.
